error: Flag scope "dicebox" is not valid or not currently active
diagnosis: BUILD v001 uses the custom flag scope dicebox. Foundry v14 requires world-owned flags to use the world scope unless the scope is an active system/module package.
recovery: Authoritatively inspect whether the T1 Scene, renderer, Walls, Regions, and AmbientLights were already created before the final flag-stamping failure.
If the exact T1 documents exist, repair/migrate metadata under flags.world.dicebox without recreating them.
If creation did not occur, issue a corrected create-only BUILD revision using the world flag scope.
